title: T-Rex Betavibe

controlChangeCommands.name: Speed Exp
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Speed expression pedal. Active only with MIDI button down.

controlChangeCommands.name: Tap Tempo
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Any value = tap. Active only with MIDI button down.

controlChangeCommands.name: Bypass
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: On/Off (bypass). Active only with MIDI button down.

additionalInfo: T-Rex Betavibe manual. MIDI button up = local knobs/footswitches; down = MIDI only (CC1 Speed Exp, CC22 Tap, CC23 Bypass). SPEED knob and SLOW/FAST–TAP footswitch deactivated in MIDI mode. Physical MODE up = Tap Tempo; MODE down = Slow/Fast Leslie ramp — those MODE behaviors are local only, not separate MIDI CCs. Complete MIDI map is CC1, 22, 23.
